source: Read-only stored customer messages from the live incident. Original parents are preserved. Outbound behavior is asserted against the corrected workflow, not replayed as new bot sends.

messages.body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to DFW (Dallas, US), including collection from our site in 22554 (Hamburg North), Germany? We’d need you to arrange the truck from our site to the airport.

The textile samples will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26. There are 9 pieces, with a gross weight of 422 kg and a total volume of 3.94 cbm.

Thanks for taking a look!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

Hi there,

Hope your day’s going well! Sorry for the change—the final packing list has come in, and the shipment details have changed to:

13 pieces, 611 kg gross weight, 5.71 cbm

Everything else stays the same. Could you update your offer with these figures, please?

Thanks for your help!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

Hi Moritz,

Thanks for checking! Please hold off on booking for now. Could you confirm whether the offer includes truck pickup from our site in 22554 on 26 November 2026, with air freight through to DFW?

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

Hi Moritz,

Thanks for checking! Before we book, could you confirm whether the offer includes pickup from our site in 22554 and trucking to HAM? The samples will be ready for pickup on 26 November 2026.

Hope your week’s going well!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

Hi Moritz,

Thanks for following up! If this is your most economical option, please go ahead and book it. The shipment will be ready for pickup on 26 November 2026.

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

Hi Moritz,

Thanks for following up! Before I give you the go-ahead, could you confirm that the offer includes truck pickup from our site in 22554 on 26 November 2026 and air freight to DFW?

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

Hi Moritz,

Thanks for the nudge! Could you resend the quote for the most economical option, including pickup from our site in 22554 and air freight to DFW? I’ll take a look before we book.

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
